answer: CD14+ monocytes (CD14 Mono) have the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes after AAV9 mini-dystrophin treatment, with 315 significant DEGs at adjusted p < 0.05 (152 up, 163 down) Post- vs Pre-AAV9 mini-dystrophin treatment — the unique leader, ahead of CD16 Mono (240) and NK (118).
